repairs.quote: Passive: Rengar will also leap Attack when Camouflaged. Active: Rengar gains 40/50/60% Move Speed and True Sight in a small area around the nearest enemy champion for 12/16/20 seconds. After 2 seconds, Rengar becomes Camouflaged and can leap without being in Brush. Leaping to the nearest champion deals an additional (100% Attack Damage) physical damage, shreds 15/20/25 Armor for 4 seconds, and ends this Ability. Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.
